allow: PowerShell(Write-Output "===== lote activo \(lo que verá el ESP32\) ====="; try { \(Invoke-WebRequest "http://localhost:8000/api/lote/activo" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 5\).Content } catch { $_.Exception.Message }; Write-Output "`n===== lotes ABIERTOS \(fin=null\) ====="; try { $j = \(Invoke-WebRequest "http://localhost:8000/api/lotes" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 5\).Content | ConvertFrom-Json; $j | Where-Object { $_.fin -eq $null } | Select-Object id, codigo, total | Format-Table -AutoSize } catch { $_.Exception.Message })
